'''Kagami-no-Miya Shrine''' (鏡宮神社) refers to Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Takasaki)|ja|鏡宮神社 (高崎市)}} - Located in Koyagi-cho, Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kagami-no-Miya|ja|鏡宮神社 (伊勢市)|lt=Kagami-no-Miya Shrine}} - Located in Asama-cho, Ise City, Mie Prefecture. A branch shrine of the {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|abstract|Q11581011|ja|皇大神宮|tok|tomo sewi suli Naku|zh|皇大神宮|qid=Q11581011}}.
